      public LobbyPreviewContext(String gameId, String nickname, int requiredPlayers, int currentPlayers, TotemSelectionDTO totemSelection)
      Builds a preview context.
      Parameters:
      gameId - lobby id to display
      nickname - local nickname to show
      requiredPlayers - required players to start
      currentPlayers - current players in the lobby
      totemSelection - snapshot of totem availability
